data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word 'gat', meaning 'gift' or 'treasure'. In the Bible, God is referred to as the giver of all good gifts. The name Gitt carries the meaning “Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gitt usually hope their child will grow to embody gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gitt total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Gitt" brings to mind the rich cultural heritage of the Hebrew language and the Bible. It is a name rooted in the traditions and values of the Jewish people, reminding us of the importance of giving and receiving gifts.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Gitt" also carries a deep spiritual significance for Christians. It is a reminder of God's role as the ultimate giver of all good gifts. In the Bible, Jesus said, "If you, then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good gifts to those who ask him!" (Matthew 7:11). The name "Gitt" is a constant reminder of the love, grace, and generosity of God towards us.
